name: my-video
description: A Remotion template for TikTok-style captions

scripts.render:policia: mkdir -p out && remotion render src/index.ts JFC-Policia out/policia-censura.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=14 --pixel-format=yuv420p --color-space=bt709 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k --jpeg-quality=95 --concurrency=4 --timeout=120000
scripts.render:peticion: mkdir -p out && remotion render src/index.ts JFC-Peticion out/peticion-completa-mezcla.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=14 --pixel-format=yuv420p --color-space=bt709 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k --jpeg-quality=95 --concurrency=4 --timeout=120000 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/peticion-completa-mezcla.mp4 -c:v copy -af volume=2dB,alimiter=limit=0.89:level=false -c:a aac -b:a 320k -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart out/peticion-completa.mp4
scripts.render:marcha: mkdir -p out && remotion render src/index.ts JFC-Marcha out/marcha-mezcla.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=14 --pixel-format=yuv420p --color-space=bt709 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k --jpeg-quality=95 --concurrency=4 --timeout=120000 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/marcha-mezcla.mp4 -c:v copy -af volume=2dB,alimiter=limit=0.89:level=false -c:a aac -b:a 320k -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart out/marcha.mp4
scripts.render:destacadas: for h in INFO JUVENTUD TERRITORIO; do remotion still src/index.ts Destacada-$h out/destacada-$h.png; done
scripts.render:nia: mkdir -p out && remotion render src/index.ts NIA out/nia-mezcla.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=14 --pixel-format=yuv420p --color-space=bt709 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k --jpeg-quality=95 --concurrency=4 --timeout=120000 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/nia-mezcla.mp4 -c:v copy -af volume=2dB,alimiter=limit=0.89:level=false -c:a aac -b:a 320k -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart out/nia.mp4
scripts.render:nia-avance: mkdir -p out && remotion render src/index.ts NIA out/nia-avance-mezcla.mp4 --scale=0.5 --codec=h264 --crf=24 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=160k --concurrency=4 --timeout=120000 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/nia-avance-mezcla.mp4 -c:v copy -af volume=2dB,alimiter=limit=0.89:level=false -c:a aac -b:a 160k -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart out/nia-avance.mp4
scripts.render:portada-derechos: remotion still src/index.ts JFC-Derechos-Portada out/portada-derechos.png && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/portada-derechos.png -q:v 2 out/portada-derechos.jpg
scripts.render:portada-museo: remotion still src/index.ts JFC-Museo-Portada out/portada-museo.png && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/portada-museo.png -q:v 2 out/portada-museo.jpg
scripts.render:derechos: mkdir -p out && remotion render src/index.ts JFC-Derechos out/derechos-mezcla.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=14 --pixel-format=yuv420p --color-space=bt709 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k --jpeg-quality=95 --concurrency=4 --timeout=120000 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/derechos-mezcla.mp4 -c:v copy -af volume=2dB,alimiter=limit=0.89:level=false -c:a aac -b:a 320k -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart out/derechos.mp4
scripts.render:derechos-avance: mkdir -p out && remotion render src/index.ts JFC-Derechos out/derechos-avance-mezcla.mp4 --scale=0.5 --codec=h264 --crf=27 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=160k --concurrency=4 --timeout=120000 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/derechos-avance-mezcla.mp4 -c:v copy -af volume=2dB,alimiter=limit=0.89:level=false -c:a aac -b:a 160k -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart out/derechos-avance.mp4

scripts.render:museo-avance: mkdir -p out && remotion render src/index.ts JFC-Museo out/museo-avance-mezcla.mp4 --scale=0.5 --codec=h264 --crf=27 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=160k --concurrency=4 --timeout=120000 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/museo-avance-mezcla.mp4 -c:v copy -af volume=2dB,alimiter=limit=0.89:level=false -c:a aac -b:a 160k -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart out/museo-avance.mp4
